clue.text: Handled a horse without hesitation

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the horse word wraps round the hesitation

parts.note: a steed is a horse
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Someone managed a horse confidently, never pausing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: To steer something is to guide or control it, so the past tense matches managed.

clue.text: Long-suffering lac is to be transferred

indicators.note: transferred means moved around, so the letters of lac is to are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: Patient lacquer is about to be moved somewhere else.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoic endures pain and hardship without complaint.

clue.text: Further education involves social engineering

definitions.meaning: night school courses for adults after work
levelling out the social strata, read as making ranks even

explanation.definitionFit: Night school courses for adults, and, read cryptically, levelling out society's ranks.

clue.text: Fine fur is back as a fashion accessory

indicators.note: is back means the letters run in reverse order

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Good-quality fur is in style again as an accessory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is back' turns F and FUR together, giving RUF then F.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruff is a stiff pleated collar worn as an ornament in Elizabethan times.

clue.text: Romantic medic gets auditor to embrace me

parts.note: DR is short for doctor, a medic

indicators.note: to embrace means to hold, so the hearing word holds the second word inside

parts.note: an auditor is a listener, and the ear is what hears
taken as written

explanation.surface: A lovesick doctor asks the accounts inspector to hug the speaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'auditor' looks like an accounts inspector but means a hearer, the EAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantic idealist lives with their head in the clouds, imagining things.

clue.text: Money to keep accountant quiet

parts.note: CA stands for chartered accountant
sh is the call for silence

explanation.surface: Hush money paid to stop a bookkeeper talking.
explanation.definitionFit: Cash is ready money in notes and coins.

clue.text: Sounds as if the beet got burnt

indicators.note: sounds as if tells us to say a word aloud to get the answer

parts.note: chard is a leaf beet

explanation.surface: It seems the beetroot was overcooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Charred means scorched black by fire.

clue.text: Shoemaker who puts on airs

definitions.meaning: an old word for a cobbler
a person who looks down on others as socially inferior

explanation.definitionFit: Snob once meant a cobbler, and now means someone pretentious.

clue.text: Missouri assembly with ethical conscience

parts.note: MO is the postal code for Missouri
a rally is a mass gathering

explanation.surface: A political gathering in Missouri claims a moral high ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting morally means acting according to principles of right and wrong.

clue.text: Follow cleric on the Opposition front bench

parts.note: to shadow is to follow closely
a minister is a clergyman

explanation.surface: A priest is tailed into Parliament's opposition seats.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the main opposition party names a spokesperson to match each government minister.
explanation.definitionFit: The opposition spokesperson who mirrors a government member sits on the front bench across the chamber.

clue.text: 11 in a queue

parts.note: the figure 11 is a 1 standing behind another 1, just as people stand in line at a bus stop

explanation.surface: A cross-reference to another clue, lined up in a queue.
explanation.walkthrough: The '11' looks like a cross-reference to 11 across, but it is just the two digits: a one followed by a one.
explanation.definitionFit: People in a queue stand in single file, each behind the next.

clue.text: Blow the cutting!

definitions.meaning: a ... round the ear is a light smack
an excerpt cut from a newspaper or film

explanation.definitionFit: Clip covers both a quick smack and a snipped excerpt from a paper.

clue.text: Complacent look causes NCO distress

parts.note: SM is a sergeant major, a non-commissioned officer
to irk is to annoy or distress

explanation.surface: A smug expression upsets a non-commissioned officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A smirk is a self-satisfied, smug smile.

clue.text: In Delhi D'Oliveira was a superstar

indicators.note: In tells us the letters sit inside the run of words Delhi D'Oliveira

explanation.surface: Basil D'Oliveira, the cricketer, was a star when playing in Delhi.
explanation.walkthrough: Basil D'Oliveira was a famous England cricketer; the answer straddles the end of Delhi and the start of his name.
explanation.definitionFit: An idol is a celebrity worshipped by fans.

clue.text: Thomas goes to a Greek monastic centre

indicators.note: goes to means the name follows on after the letter a

parts.note: Thos is the standard written abbreviation of the name Thomas

explanation.surface: A man named Thomas travels to a holy site in Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: Mount Athos in northern Greece is home to many Orthodox monasteries.
explanation.definitionFit: Mount Athos is a Greek peninsula famous for its Orthodox monasteries.

clue.text: Sweet bread

explanation.definitionFit: Lolly is British slang both for a lollipop and for cash.

clue.text: A striker carrying less weight

definitions.meaning: something that strikes a flame for a cigarette
having less weight, not as heavy

explanation.definitionFit: A cigarette lighter makes a flame, and lighter also means weighing less.

clue.text: Cross over the road to make an entrance

indicators.note: over in a down-the-page sense of turned over, so the cross word is read backwards

parts.note: a rood is a crucifix, a cross
a way is a road, as in a highway

explanation.surface: Someone crosses the street in order to arrive somewhere grandly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' signals the reversal; 'Cross' looks like a verb but is a noun, the crucifix.
explanation.definitionFit: A doorway is the opening through which one enters a building.

clue.text: Governor initially concedes sit deterred criminals

indicators.note: initially means take only the opening letter of Governor

parts.note: to allow a point is to concede it

explanation.surface: A prison governor admits that harsh punishment once put off lawbreakers.
explanation.definitionFit: The hangman's scaffold was meant to frighten would-be offenders into obeying the law.

clue.text: Girl taking a meal came to life

definitions.note: elliptical: the one who came to life, the sculpted figure

parts.note: gal is a girl
tea is an evening meal in Britain

explanation.surface: A girl eats a meal and is revived.
explanation.walkthrough: In legend Pygmalion carved a statue that the gods brought to life; she was later named Galatea.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Pygmalion myth the ivory statue of a woman was animated by Aphrodite.

clue.text: Tool needed to construct a bridge

definitions.meaning: something that spans a gap, as a bridge does

explanation.definitionFit: A spanner is a wrench, and literally anything that spans across.

clue.text: Took so long that everyone inside expired

indicators.note: inside puts the word for everyone within the word for expired

parts.note: expired means died
all means everyone

explanation.surface: Someone delayed so long that the whole party perished.
explanation.definitionFit: To dally is to dawdle or waste time.

clue.text: Sibyl leaves cafe around teatime

indicators.note: around means the eating place wraps round the time

parts.note: a diner is a cheap restaurant
four o'clock is teatime, written IV in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A prophetess walks out of a café at about four.
explanation.definitionFit: A sibyl was a prophetess, a foreteller of the future.

clue.text: Wanted baronet to enter contract

indicators.note: to enter means go inside, so the title goes within the document

parts.note: a deed is a legal contract
a baronet is addressed as Sir

explanation.surface: A titled gentleman was eager to sign an agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: Desired means longed for or wished for.

clue.text: Left East German in state of confusion

parts.note: Ost is the German word for east

explanation.surface: Someone abandoned an East German official in a muddle.
explanation.definitionFit: Being lost means being bewildered and not knowing what to do.

clue.text: Husband admits money is a comfort

indicators.note: admits means lets in, so the word for husband takes the money letter inside

parts.note: to husband resources is to save them
L is the pound sign, so it stands for money

explanation.surface: A married man says cash is a consolation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Husband' is a verb here, meaning to save carefully, not a spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A salve is a soothing ointment, and figuratively anything that soothes or consoles.

clue.text: Utter contempt for the man's son

parts.note: his means belonging to him, the man
S is the abbreviation for son in family trees

explanation.surface: A father feels scorn for his boy.
explanation.definitionFit: To hiss is to make a sharp sibilant noise showing disapproval or scorn.

clue.text: Set of rules broken by cryptographers

definitions.meaning: a body of laws or conventions

explanation.definitionFit: A code is a body of laws, and also a cipher that codebreakers crack.

clue.text: Inclination to use pious platitudes

explanation.definitionFit: Cant is a slope or tilt, and also hollow sanctimonious talk.

clue.text: Tonight men fear Rex may get a hangover

indicators.note: may get suggests the letters of those three words are turned into something new

parts.note: R stands for Rex, king, as on coins

explanation.surface: Men worry that the king will suffer from drinking too much tonight.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of TONIGHT, MEN and FEAR, rearranged, give THEMORNINGAFTE; adding R completes it.
explanation.definitionFit: The morning after is a phrase for the queasy after-effects of heavy drinking.

clue.text: Woman's right to a German title

parts.note: her means belonging to a woman

explanation.surface: A woman claims she is entitled to a German honour.
explanation.definitionFit: Herr is the German form of address for a man, equivalent to Mr.

clue.text: Angry about tax being withdrawn

parts.note: re means about or concerning
T can stand for tax
ired means made angry

explanation.surface: Someone is furious at a levy being scrapped.
explanation.definitionFit: Retired can describe a shy, reserved person who keeps to themselves, or one who has gone away.
